### Performed both a logistic regression and fisher's test on multiple masses in one location and multiple in two or more locations but the p-values were both too large and confidence intervals to wide to conclude that there really is a relationship. (Really wanted to prove that multiple nodules condensed in one location were more likely to rupture but didnt :()). Now I'm going to combine the diffuse into two or more locations and maybe it'll work? Prob not though because the sample size for multiple in one location is still small. 

```{r}
New_Spleen$spread_status2 <- NA_character_

New_Spleen$spread_status2[New_Spleen$location_group %in% c("Body","Head","Tail") &  New_Spleen$`Number of nodules` == "multiple"] <- "Multiple in one location"

New_Spleen$spread_status2[New_Spleen$location_group %in% c("Multiple", "Diffuse") & New_Spleen$`Number of nodules` == "multiple"] <- "Multiple across locations" 
# Now including diffuse in this category!
```

```{r}
table(New_Spleen$spread_status2, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
table(New_Spleen$spread_status2, New_Spleen$rupture)
```

```{r}
prop.table(table(New_Spleen$spread_status2, New_Spleen$rupture), margin = 1)
```
```{r}
spread_model_wdiffuse <- glm(
  rupture ~ spread_status2,
  family = binomial,
  data = New_Spleen
)

summary(spread_model_wdiffuse)
```

```{r}
exp(coef(spread_model_wdiffuse))
```
```{r}
exp(confint(spread_model_wdiffuse))
```

```{r}
fisher.test(New_Spleen$spread_status2, New_Spleen$rupture)
```

```{r}
### Binary interaction: one mass and one location and more than one mass and more than one location
```

```{r}
New_Spleen$location_binary <- ifelse(New_Spleen$location_group2 == "Multiple",
                                     "More_than_one_location",
                                     "One_location")
```

```{r}
New_Spleen$location_binary <- factor(New_Spleen$location_binary)
New_Spleen$location_binary <- relevel(New_Spleen$location_binary, ref = "One_mass")
```

```{r}
)
```

```{r}
New_Spleen$nodule_binary <- ifelse(
  New_Spleen$`Number of nodules` == "one",
  "One_mass",
  "More_than_one_mass"
)
```

```{r}
New_Spleen$nodule_binary <- factor(New_Spleen$nodule_binary)
```

```{r}
New_Spleen$nodule_binary <- relevel(New_Spleen$nodule_binary, ref = "One_mass")
```

```{r}
levels(New_Spleen$location_binary)
```

```{r}
table(New_Spleen$location_binary, New_Spleen$nodule_binary, New_Spleen$rupture)
```

```{r}
binary_model <- glm(rupture ~ location_binary + nodule_binary,
              data = New_Spleen,
              family = binomial)

summary(binary_model)
```

```{r}
binary_model_interactions <- glm(rupture ~ location_binary * nodule_binary,
              data = New_Spleen,
              family = binomial)

summary(binary_model_interactions)
```
